description: Course content, assignments, discussions, grading in progress, and live sessions for about 238,000 online students in 8-week sessions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Weekly assignment and exam deadlines; LMS activity is the attendance evidence for online students; six online start dates a year; student complaints and refunds rise after one day
manual_workaround: Faculty announce deadline extensions by email and text; read-only course packets published from the last content export; live sessions moved to the video conferencing service
quantified_impact_basis: About 55% of daily online tuition at risk through deadline extensions, tuition credits, and withdrawals (online tuition about $10.7 million per day)
service_line_or_partner_dependency: SL-2: the 14 partner institutions share the same LMS platform (BP-12)

description: Classes, labs, and simulation at 23 campuses; clinical placement rosters and student clearance records (immunizations, background checks) for partner hospitals
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Classes can run with local resources; clinical sites will not accept students without current clearance lists
manual_workaround: Printed rosters; weekly clearance list exports kept by clinical coordinators; simulation labs run from local systems
dependent_people_or_facilities: Campus faculty and clinical coordinators; 23 campuses
quantified_impact_basis: Cancelled labs and clinical shifts that must be made up (overtime and site fees) for about 47,000 campus students

business_process: Registration, enrollment status, and academic records
description: Registration, add/drop, enrollment status, grades, degree audit, and transcripts in the SIS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Six online start dates and three campus terms a year; enrollment status drives Title IV eligibility and disbursement; grade and transcript integrity
manual_workaround: Printed rosters; paper add/drop log; grade changes frozen until the SIS returns
quantified_impact_basis: Delayed starts and add/drop processing for about 20,000 students per start date, plus overtime for back-entry
service_line_or_partner_dependency: SL-1 employer progress reports and SL-2 roster feeds depend on enrollment status
single_points_of_failure: Single SIS instance (warm standby in a second region)

description: ISIR intake through SAIG, verification, packaging, Direct Loan origination, and disbursement reporting to the Department
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Aid must be packaged before each session starts; daily ISIR batches; Department reporting deadlines; about $8.8 million of Title IV funds disbursed per day on average
manual_workaround: ISIRs stay queued in the SAIG mailbox; urgent cases processed in the Department web systems by individually issued accounts; manual award letters
dependent_third_parties: Department of Education systems; Title IV third-party servicer
quantified_impact_basis: Title IV cash deferred (about $8.8 million per day), plus about $0.3 million of cash carrying cost and overtime
single_points_of_failure: Department of Education systems (external; outside the company's control)

description: Applying Title IV funds to student accounts and paying credit balances to students and parents (about 410,000 refunds a year)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Title IV credit balances must be paid no later than 14 days after they occur (34 CFR 668.164(h)(2)); peaks in the week after each session start; students depend on refunds for living costs
manual_workaround: Paper checks issued through the bank portal to last verified bank details; credit balance report from the financial aid module rebuilt manually
dependent_third_parties: Bank (refund disbursement files); payment plan servicer
quantified_impact_basis: Late-refund remediation, overtime, and check processing; the regulatory deadline dominates
single_points_of_failure: Single bank for refund files (secondary bank account exists but no file format tested)

description: Inquiry handling, applications, and enrollment advising for new students (about 1.6 million inquiries a year)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Speed of contact drives new starts; about 4,400 inquiries a day; six online start dates a year
manual_workaround: Web forms queue in the marketing platform; advisors work from exported call lists
dependent_third_parties: Admissions CRM vendor; contact-center overflow vendor; telephony carriers
quantified_impact_basis: Deferred or lost new starts (about 160 new students a day at an average first-year value of about $16,000)

business_process: Student support center and 24x7 technical help desk
description: Phone, chat, and ticket support for students, faculty, and SL-2 partner students
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Students locked out cannot study or submit work; SL-2 contracts require 24x7 support
manual_workaround: Contact-center overflow vendor takes calls on a scripted basis; status page and text alerts
dependent_systems: SYS-08 telephony core; SYS-05; ticketing SaaS
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits under SL-2 contracts plus overtime and lost productivity
single_points_of_failure: Telephony core in the colocation data center

description: Self-service for registration, grades, balances, aid offers, and refund bank details
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Students can use the support center; portal outages during session start drive call volume
manual_workaround: Support center agents act for students after identity verification; registration by advisors
quantified_impact_basis: Additional support center volume and delayed self-service transactions

description: Proctored exams and high-stakes assessments for online courses
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Exams can be rescheduled within the 8-week session; licensure-prep exams have fixed windows
manual_workaround: Unproctored alternative assessments approved by deans; rescheduled exam windows
quantified_impact_basis: Rescheduling and staff time; student complaints

business_process: Transcripts, enrollment verification, and records release
description: Official transcripts, enrollment and degree verification, and responses to records requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: FERPA access requests must be met within 45 days (34 CFR 99.10(b)); employers and licensing boards expect verification within days
manual_workaround: Manual transcripts from the last SIS export with registrar sign-off
service_line_or_partner_dependency: SL-1 employers use degree verification for tuition-benefit reimbursement

business_process: Workforce Education Services employer portal and invoicing (SL-1)
description: Employer portal for sponsored-student enrollment and progress (with student FERPA consent) and tuition-benefit invoicing for about 310 employer clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client contracts commit to 99.9% monthly availability and SOC 2 controls (P09); invoicing cycles are monthly
manual_workaround: Progress reports sent by secure file transfer from SIS exports; invoices delayed
dependent_systems: SL-1 portal (Cloud provider A); SYS-01; SYS-05
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits and delayed invoicing for about 52,000 sponsored students

business_process: Online Program Services for partner institutions (SL-2)
description: LMS tenant hosting, course operations, 24x7 student support, and learning analytics for 14 partner institutions (about 41,000 partner students)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Partner contracts set an 8-hour recovery commitment for LMS service; partners' students face the same deadlines as College students
manual_workaround: Partner faculty extend deadlines; read-only course packets; partner help desks escalate to the College support center
dependent_systems: SYS-02 partner tenants; SYS-05; partner SIS roster feeds
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits and remediation commitments under partner contracts; renewal risk
single_points_of_failure: Single LMS vendor platform (shared with BP-01)

description: Emergency notifications, physical access control, and CCTV at 23 campuses
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The campus community must be notified immediately on confirmation of a significant emergency (34 CFR 668.46(g)(1)); access control protects people on campus
manual_workaround: Campus public address systems, phone trees, and local law enforcement; door controllers fail secure with keyed override
dependent_third_parties: Emergency notification service; physical access control vendor
quantified_impact_basis: Direct cost is small; the safety and regulatory impact dominates

business_process: Payroll and HR, including adjunct contracts
description: Payroll for 12,000 employees, adjunct term contracts and pay, onboarding and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; adjunct contract feeds also drive account disablement (P02 PS-4)
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll with manual adjustments; paper contract notices
dependent_third_parties: ERP, HR, and payroll SaaS vendor
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime, manual payments, and late-pay penalties

description: Monthly and quarterly close, revenue recognition, and SEC filings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines tighten the MTD to 48 hours in the quarter-end window
manual_workaround: Spreadsheet close from the last ledger export; filing extension only as a last resort
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime and outside advisor fees; the regulatory impact dominates at quarter-end

business_process: Tuition billing, payment plans, and collections
description: Student billing, card and ACH payments, institutional payment plans, and collections
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash timing only; payment plan servicer can accept payments independently
manual_workaround: Payment processor hosted pages keep taking payments; posting is deferred
dependent_third_parties: Payment processor; tuition payment plan servicer
quantified_impact_basis: Deferred non-Title IV receipts (about $4.4 million a day) and waived late fees

description: Student-success risk scores (AI-003) and advisor outreach lists
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Outreach can use the last published lists; scores are refreshed weekly
manual_workaround: Advisors use last week's outreach list and LMS activity reports
service_line_or_partner_dependency: SL-2 learning analytics reports to partners
